newsitem.title: INDIA: Bomb explodes on Indian train.
newsitem.headline: Bomb explodes on Indian train.

text.p: A powerful bomb exploded on a moving train in northern India on Tuesday, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.
The news agency said the number of casualties was not immediately known.
PTI said the explosion occurred in Lehrakhanna town in the state of Punjab. Punjab was rocked by a bloody Sikh separatist movement in the 1980s.
No other details were immediately available.
